---
title: "Advanced Scheduling Systems — Interactive Companions"
---

Interactive visualizations for the **Advanced Scheduling Systems** course at the University of Udine.

Each notebook lets you step through classic scheduling algorithms with sliders and custom inputs — all running directly in your browser via [Pyodide](https://pyodide.org), no installation required.

## Notebooks

### Chapter 1 — Introduction to Scheduling

1. [**Critical Path Method (CPM)**](notebooks/01-cpm.qmd) — Forward pass, backward pass, and critical path on a precedence DAG
2. [**Knapsack: Greedy Strategies Compared**](notebooks/02-knapsack.qmd) — Max value, min weight, best ratio, and fractional relaxation side by side
3. [**DSatur: Graph Colouring**](notebooks/03-dsatur.qmd) — Step through saturation-degree colouring vs max-degree ordering
